billing_notes: Public Workers AI price tables and neuron billing rules, including non-token modalities. Neurons and tokens are not assumed interchangeable.

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: Last updated Oct 9, 2026|Copy as Markdown| [View as Markdown](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md)| [Agent setup](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agent-setup/)

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: Our free allocation allows anyone to use a total of **10,000 Neurons per day at no charge**. To use more than 10,000 Neurons per day, you need to sign up for the [Workers Paid plan](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/#workers). On Workers Paid, you will be charged at $0.011 / 1,000 Neurons for any usage above the free allocation of 10,000 Neurons per day.

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: Some models require a paid billing method. This applies to `@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6`, `@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code`, `@cf/zai-org/glm-5.2`, `@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3`, `@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash`, `@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash-0731`, and `@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-0813`. You can access these models with either the [Workers Paid plan](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/#workers) or prepaid [AI Gateway credits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/).

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: The Price in Tokens column is equivalent to the Price in Neurons column - the different units are displayed so you can easily compare and understand pricing.

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: Workers AI has updated pricing to be more granular, with per-model unit-based pricing presented, but still billing in neurons in the back end.

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: Workers AI is included in both the [Free and Paid Workers plans](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/) and is priced at **$0.011 per 1,000 Neurons**.

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: You can use prepaid [AI Gateway credits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/) to pay for Workers AI inference. Set the gateway's [Workers AI billing setting](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/configuration/manage-gateway/#configure-workers-ai-billing) to **Unified billing**, then specify that gateway in the [AI binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/usage/worker-binding-methods/) or REST API request.
https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/index.md: description: Workers AI pricing is based on Neurons, with a free daily allocation and per-model rates.
